name: send-html-email
description: Delivery-pattern HTML email sender. Reads {html, subject} from the upstream node's output, RFC 2047-encodes non-ASCII subjects, and POSTs an HTML message to the Gmail API using a Bearer token (a vault:// reference in AUTH_HEADER is resolved host-side). DRY_RUN gates the send. `skip: true` from the upstream node sends nothing; an input with no `html` is an error, never a blank email. Costs about 55 fuel per byte of `html`; the default limit is sized for a message of up to 60 KB, so set the node's `max_fuel` higher for a longer one. Pair with a compose node (memory, no network) per the two-node delivery pattern.

AUTH_HEADER.description: Authorization header value, e.g. 'Bearer vault://oauth/gmail/<account>/<email>/access_token'. A vault:// reference is resolved host-side and never exposed to the guest.

FROM.description: Sender address; defaults to 'me' (the authenticated account).

DRY_RUN.description: When true, build the message but do not call Gmail; returns {sent:false, dry_run:true, rfc822_bytes}. Default false.

input_contract.description: Content is taken from the upstream node's output (the compose leg of the delivery pattern).

properties.subject: Email subject line (RFC 2047-encoded automatically if non-ASCII).
properties.html: HTML email body (sent as text/html; charset=UTF-8). Required unless skip is true: a missing or empty html is an error and nothing is sent.
properties.skip: Optional boolean. true means the composer has nothing to send this time: nothing is sent and the output is {sent:false, skipped:true}.

output.skipped: true when the upstream node returned skip: true (absent otherwise)
output.subject: the original (un-encoded) subject
output.rfc822_bytes: size of the built message (DRY_RUN only)

setup_instructions.title: Grant the Gmail OAuth token to the sending actor
setup_instructions.detail: Store/authorize a Gmail OAuth access token at a vault path such as oauth/gmail/<account>/<email>/access_token and grant the actor access to it.

setup_instructions.title: Reference it in AUTH_HEADER
setup_instructions.detail: Set the node config AUTH_HEADER to 'Bearer vault://<that path>'. The host substitutes the token into the outbound Authorization header and zeroizes the plaintext after the request.

setup_instructions.title: Wire a compose node upstream
setup_instructions.detail: Connect a compose node that emits {html, subject}. Keep memory access on the compose node and network access on this send node (privilege separation).
